name: hono-socialweb-computer-k8s
description: Kubernetes front door for the social web computer: atproto OAuth, a cluster list, kubeconfig downloads, and market-provisioned nodes

http-port.description: Port the web app and API listen on

serve-addr.description: Address the web app and API bind

state-dir.description: Directory holding OAuth sessions when no OpenBaoServer is named

web-dir.description: Directory the single page app is served from

public-origin.description: Public https origin this door is reached at; names the OAuth client_id and binds request proofs

oauth-client-id.description: Fallback OAuth client_id to refresh as when a deposited session carries none

network-hosts.description: Comma-separated name=address pairs of the market network's service names (its PDSes, PLC, relay) and the loopback address each answers on, copied from the Gateway's network value

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory used to resolve accounts

ingress-proxy-host.description: did-key ingress proxy the requester registers its own repo with

gateway-url.description: Base URL of the cluster gateway XRPC surface; unset, it is read from the listeners in the status of the Gateway object gateway-kcp-name in gateway-kcp-workspace through kcp-kubeconfig

gateway-kcp-workspace.description: kcp workspace of the Gateway object whose status names the cluster gateway's XRPC listener

gateway-kcp-name.description: Name of the Gateway object whose status names the cluster gateway's XRPC listener

gateway-kcp-listener.description: Name of the cluster gateway's XRPC listener in the Gateway status

gateway-audience.description: Audience the cluster gateway accepts service-auth tokens for; must be one of SOCIALWEB_GATEWAY_AUDIENCES

kcp-public-host.description: Public kcp front kubeconfigs point at, shown on the page

kubeconfig-max-ttl-sec.description: Longest kubeconfig certificate lifetime a user may pick (at most 86400)

downloads-subdir.description: Subdirectory of the web dir that holds the pinned downloads when downloads-dir is not set

downloads-dir.description: Directory of the pinned downloads served at /downloads/<sha256>/<name>: each <name> beside a sha256sum-format <name>.sha256 (socialweb-meshd-<arch>, socialweb-credential-<os>-<arch>); the socialweb-computer binary passes its socialweb-computer-k8s-downloads asset

required-downloads.description: Comma-separated names of pinned downloads this web app must serve; it refuses to start when one is missing, or when a socialweb-meshd download is required and no origin for node downloads is set

tls-cert-file.description: Serve TLS with this certificate file

tls-key-file.description: Serve TLS with this key file

port-file.description: Write the bound port to this file once listening

kcp-kubeconfig.description: kubeconfig of this web app's own kcp identity (a ServiceAccount token, re-read from its tokenFile on every request); it reads the Gateway and the OpenBaoServer and writes MarketIdentities

kcp-server.description: kcp server (base URL) this web app reaches its own kcp identity's objects on, with kcp-token-file and kcp-ca-file; used when kcp-kubeconfig is unset

kcp-token-file.description: File holding this web app's own ServiceAccount token for kcp-server, re-read on every request

kcp-ca-file.description: PEM CA bundle kcp-server's certificate chains to

kcp-workspace.description: This web app's own kcp workspace; with kcp-kubeconfig set, it fulfils through the compute market the NodeClaims of every home that the cluster gateway names in a ConfigMap labelled socialweb.computer/nodeclaim-home in its default namespace

kcp-context.description: Context in the kcp kubeconfig to use; defaults to its current-context

node-extra-bidder-dids.description: Comma-separated bidders to admit for node contracts without a vouch record in the owner's repo

node-policy.description: Fulfilment policy a node's RFP is evaluated under

relay-url.description: Comma-separated extra relays to watch for bids

vm-ready-timeout-sec.description: How long a node's VM may take from the accept to fetching its join secrets

openbao-server.description: Name of the OpenBaoServer object (in openbao-server-workspace, read through kcp-kubeconfig) whose client openbao-client holds this web app's OAuth sessions and the join-secret bundle of each NodeClaim contract; unset, the sessions are files in state-dir and no node is fulfilled

openbao-client.description: Client of the OpenBaoServer this web app logs in as with its client certificate; its kvMount holds the sessions and the bundles

openbao-client-dir.description: Directory holding that client's certificate (tls.crt), key (tls.key) and the vault CA (ca.crt), kept current by the DenoPod's projected credentials; unset, they are read from the files the OpenBaoServer status names

openbao-server-workspace.description: kcp workspace of the OpenBaoServer object

market-identity-workspace.description: kcp workspace this web app writes one MarketIdentity (mode oauthDelegated) per signed-in account into; unset, it writes none

cluster-ca-dir.description: Directory of each tenant cluster's public OpenBao CA (<cluster data dir name>.crt) that the cluster provider publishes; unset, the CA is read beside the cluster's token file

contract-kcp-workspace.description: kcp workspace the ComputeContract of each NodeClaim is written into; the requester controller of the same Gateway application carries it out

test-owner-sessions-file.description: TEST ONLY: JSON object keyed by owner DID of {service, identifier, password}; those owners rent nodes through a password session instead of their deposited OAuth session. Never set in production

test-node-download-host.description: TEST ONLY: the address at which a node guest reaches this host's loopback; node guests download pinned downloads from http://<this>:<the bound http port> instead of public-origin, for a market network on one host

test-node-user-data-base-file.description: TEST ONLY: cloud-config every node's user_data is composed onto, for a market whose dispatcher speaks TLS under a private CA
